texts: good. adjudicated accept — "rarely" is carried on both channels (a low truth-strength on the ordering plus an explicit "rarely" record), and "orders Keepers to burn wintergloss" is routed as object control, with the Keepers as the burners and wintergloss as what is burned. One thing to be aware of rather than to rewrite: the solid spelling "wintergloss" is read as modifier + head, so the parse also asserts that a wintergloss is a kind of gloss — harmless if that holds in the lore, mildly wrong if the plant name is arbitrary.
